title: Trend vs chop, last 30 min
source: SPX 1-min closes: |net move| / sum of |1-min moves| over the last 30 minutes, or since 09:35 before 10:05; ranked against the same measure at the same minute on the trailing 20 sessions (at least 10): top third clean, middle mixed, bottom choppy.
notes: Fix applied: before 10:05 the window runs from the settled open (09:35), so it replaces opening_chop on the tape lane. Needs 25 bars (5 before 10:05).

title: VWAP balance: one-sided or orbiting
source: SPY minute bars (state/spx_jev/context/bars/{day}.jsonl (prior sessions; the day's own bars cut at the read, or context/{day}.jsonl quotes live)): session VWAP = cumulative typical price x volume / volume; minutes since SPY's last 5-minute close (09:34, 09:39, ...) on the other side of its VWAP, and the bars of the last 30 minutes whose high-low held the VWAP; each ranked against the same measure at the same minute on the trailing 20 sessions (at least 10). Touches top third = orbiting; else minutes-since top third = long one-sided; else recently crossed.
notes: VWAP is volume-weighted from SPY's own minute volume (SPX bars carry none); the fix's 60-session backfill is not applied: the history is the builder's 20 sessions. DRAFT: the orbiting-first precedence.

title: Volume spike follow-through, signed
source: SPY volume per finished 5-minute slot (09:30-09:34, ...) of the last 30 minutes; a slot whose volume is at or above the 90th percentile of the same slot on the trailing 20 sessions (at least 10) is a spike; the latest spike's SPX direction = close - open over the slot, held when the latest SPX close is past the slot's high-low midpoint in that direction.
notes: Fix applied: volume from SPY's minute bars ({CTX}), since $SPX has none. DRAFT: the 90th-percentile cut (the question's 'top 10%').

title: Range compressing or expanding
source: SPX 1-min bars: high-low range of the last 30 minutes over the range of the 30 minutes before it; ranked against the same measure at the same minute on the trailing 20 sessions (at least 10): bottom third compressed, top expanded.
notes: Needs 25 bars in each half hour, so None before 10:30.

title: VIX open vs what the gap implies
source: $VIX and SPX minute bars (state/spx_jev/context/bars/{day}.jsonl (prior sessions; the day's own bars cut at the read, or context/{day}.jsonl quotes live)): the 09:35 VIX (the 09:34 bar's close) less (the prior session's last VIX + VIX_PER_GAP_PCT x the gap from the prior close to the settled open in percent); ranked against the same measure on the trailing 20 sessions (at least 10): top third richer, bottom cheaper.
notes: Fix applied: the 09:35 VIX print, not the first diary print; walk-forward (prior sessions only). Opening reads only: reads from 09:35 to 10:35 answer, later ones None. DRAFT: VIX_PER_GAP_PCT = -1.7 points per 1% gap (labels/vol.py's -1.7 per sigma, a sigma near 1%).

title: Gap size in implied units
source: SPX bars (bars/ and store spx_bars, 60 sessions): gap = settled open (09:34 close) - prior close; implied one-day move = prior close x prior-close $VIX (daily_closes) / 100 / sqrt(252); |gap / implied| ranked against the same on the trailing 60 sessions (at least 10): bottom third small, middle normal, top large, signed by the gap.
notes: Fix applied: the prior-close VIX / sqrt(252) ruler and a 60-session rank. The premarket half (/ES vs 16:00 before 09:35) is not built: the live lane has no read before 09:35. LEVELS-01 keeps its own gap-fill answer.

title: Front VIX curve shape
source: $VIX9D / $VIX at the read (state/spx_jev/context/bars/{day}.jsonl (prior sessions; the day's own bars cut at the read, or context/{day}.jsonl quotes live)): at or above 1.00 = inverted; else ranked against the same measure at the same minute on the trailing 20 sessions (at least 10): bottom third calm, otherwise normal.
notes: Fix applied: ranked against the sessions on file (the context bars, from 2026-08-11), not a year; VIX/VIX3M is not used as a fallback.

title: Vol fails to confirm a new extreme
source: SPX bars: a session high (low) set in the last 30 minutes above (below) an earlier one; $VIX (state/spx_jev/context/bars/{day}.jsonl (prior sessions; the day's own bars cut at the read, or context/{day}.jsonl quotes live)) at the new extreme's minute against VIX at the earlier extreme's: a new high with VIX at or below, or a new low with VIX at or above, is confirmed; else vol disagrees. Mechanical first: the read in the last hour (from 15:00), a Friday or pre-holiday session, or a calendar row in its first 15 minutes.
notes: Converted from JEV to code. Same-day ATM IV is not read (VIX only); VIX expiry days are not a mechanical cause yet. Shares one vote with BREADTH-03.

title: Recent days' range regime
source: daily_closes/$SPX.jsonl (sessions before the day): daily range = (high - low) / close; the mean of the last 5 sessions ranked against the trailing 60 sessions' rolling 5-session means: bottom third quiet, top wide.
notes: Ranked against recent sessions (60), per Will's note. The context fields (10-session trend strength, intraday character) are not stored: the matrix holds answers only.

title: Overnight range position
source: The read's /ES quote (market_context) against the night's /ES high and low (overnight/{day}.jsonl, session != regular, bars before 09:30). Roll guard: the quote more than 2% from the night's last bar is another contract, so None.
notes: 147 nights on disk; the guard's 2% is a DRAFT.

title: Room to the next barrier
source: In the direction of SPX's last 30-minute move, the distance (share of price) to the nearest level beyond price: the prior session's high, low and close, the night's /ES high and low moved onto SPX by the 09:30 basis, today's session high and low, the next round number (25-point steps); ranked against the same measure at the same minute on the trailing 20 sessions (at least 10): bottom third close, top far.
notes: Walls and VWAP are not in the level library yet (no wall history for the prior sessions; the S11 library is not built), so the rank is over the same levels on every session. DRAFT: the 25-point round numbers.

title: Which side is tiring at a tested edge or extreme
source: Edges: today's high and low before the last 30 minutes, the prior session's high and low. A test = a run of bars reaching within 0.05 sigma of the edge; an edge with 2+ runs in the last 30 minutes (the latest-tested wins). First run vs latest: depth past the edge, SPY volume over the run, rejection (the extreme against the closes of the 3 bars after); the latest shallower, lighter and sharper-rejected on 2 of 3 = buyers tiring at a high edge, sellers tiring at a low edge.
notes: Converted from JEV to code without the S11 test ledger: the three ratios compare the latest test with the first directly, not ranked against the time of day. The weaker-extreme field (J2-02) is not stored. DRAFT thresholds: 0.05 sigma touch, 3 rejection bars, 2 of 3.

title: Wall test in the last hour
source: The day's SPX diary rows (reversion/{day}.jsonl) at each bar of the last 60 minutes: the 0DTE and 1-to-7-day call and put walls; a bar whose high-low reaches within 0.10 sigma (the label's touch rule) of a wall touches it; the latest touch's wall, with price now at or on the held side (at or below a call wall, at or above a put wall) = held, else broke.
notes: Never empty when the diary and bars are on file (the live label is missing on a quarter of reads). Shares the held-or-failed vote.

title: Pin holding or breaking loose
source: The diary's magnet, 0DTE and 1-to-7-day walls at the read; over the last 60 minutes' SPX closes, a level crossed 3+ times is the pin (the most crossed); price now more than one 30-minute expected move (sigma x sqrt(30/390)) from it = broke loose; the current swing away wider than the median earlier swing and longer (bars since the last crossing) = stretching; else holding.
notes: Moved from JEV to code. DRAFT: 3 crossings, medians of the earlier swings. Shares the pinned vote.

title: Same-day option quote width
source: The lob-flow collector's quote sweeps (state/lob_flow/raw/{day}/sweeps.jsonl(.gz)): the 25-40 delta bucket's quoted spread, the median of the last 5 minutes' sweeps, ranked against the same minute on the trailing 20 sessions (at least 10): under a third tight, under two thirds normal, under 0.9 wide, else very wide.
notes: The sweep carries no vega, so the spread is ranked in dollars, not per unit of vega. 21 days of sweeps on file.

title: Short-dated hedge buying
source: A 1-to-7-day put-to-call volume ratio over the last 30 minutes, ranked against this time of day.
notes: needs_new_feed: no source carries 1-to-7-day volume by strike. The diary holds the 0DTE volume by strike (gex_views.vol_side_by_strike) and the 1-to-7-day net gamma by strike only, and the lob-flow collector sweeps the 0DTE chain only; adding a second expiry's sweep is not a pure addition to the daemon. Always None until a feed exists.

title: NYSE breadth beyond the day move (live lane)
source: The read's derived advance-decline ($ADVN - $DECN, else $ADD) against SPX's move since the prior close: on the trailing 20 sessions at this minute the line (from state/spx_jev/context/bars/{day}.jsonl (prior sessions; the day's own bars cut at the read, or context/{day}.jsonl quotes live)) is regressed on the move; today's residual ranked against the sessions' residuals: top third stronger, bottom weaker.
notes: Live lane only (the derived line is the live reading). Needs 10 sessions with both; the store's $ADVN starts 09-28, the context bars files earlier.

title: Breadth and small caps confirm a new extreme
source: A new session high (low) in the last 30 minutes (as VOLATILITY-14); three confirmations: the derived advance-decline now above (below) its level at the earlier extreme's minute; IWM within 0.05% of its own session high (low); the 8 largest names' weighted return from the earlier extreme's minute to now positive (negative). Weights: state/spx_leaders/weights.json, the entry dated on or before the day; prices from state/spx_jev/context/bars/{day}.jsonl (prior sessions; the day's own bars cut at the read, or context/{day}.jsonl quotes live).
notes: $VOLD leg replaced by the derived $ADD. None before the first weights entry (2026-10-06). DRAFT: the 0.05% IWM tolerance. Shares one vote with VOLATILITY-14.

title: Biggest heavyweight shock beyond SPX
source: The 8 largest names (weights dated on or before the day; GOOG summed into GOOGL, BRK/B as the feed names it): each one's 30-minute return less its usual multiple of SPX's (the slope of its 30-minute returns on SPX's over the prior sessions' half hours, at least 20 pairs); the largest weight x residual; |pull| ranked against the largest pull at the same minute on the trailing sessions: top third large (signed), else small; followed when 4+ of the other 7 moved beyond SPX the same way.
notes: Weights are taken as of on or before the read's day (the task's rule), not strictly before as the question's note asked; the first entry is 2026-10-06, so earlier reads are None. TSLA and BRK/B are in the feed since 08-21.

title: Day's leader fading
source: The name whose weight x return since the settled open contributed most in SPX's day direction (SPX's close now against its 09:34 close); its 30-minute return beyond its usual multiple of SPX, |residual| ranked against its own at this minute: bottom third neither; else against the day direction fading, with it kept leading.
notes: Same weights rule as BREADTH-07; shadow.

title: Heavyweight in play since the close (gate)
source: Each of the 8 largest names' return since the prior session's close less its usual multiple (BREADTH-07's) of SPX's since the same close, weighted; |largest pull| top third at this minute against the trailing sessions = in play; the rest of the index (SPX's move less the names' weighted moves) followed when it has the pull's sign and is above the bottom third of its own.
notes: Gate for BREADTH-10 (no vote). DRAFT: the 30-minute multiple stands in for a since-the-close one.

title: Volume backs the move
source: Over the last 30 minutes the share of SPY's minute volume (state/spx_jev/context/bars/{day}.jsonl (prior sessions; the day's own bars cut at the read, or context/{day}.jsonl quotes live)) traded in the minutes SPX's bar closed the way the half hour went (close - open of the window); ranked against the same measure at the same minute on the trailing 20 sessions (at least 10): top third confirmed, bottom diverging.
notes: A flat half hour (net 0) is None. Drop if Cramer's V vs TREND-01 >= 0.7 (not measured here).

title: Price travel per volume
source: SPX points travelled (sum of |1-min moves|) over the last 30 minutes per million SPY shares (state/spx_jev/context/bars/{day}.jsonl (prior sessions; the day's own bars cut at the read, or context/{day}.jsonl quotes live)); ranked against the same measure at the same minute on the trailing 20 sessions (at least 10): bottom third heavy with little travel, top easy travel on light volume.
notes: Amihud thinness. Keep only if < 0.8 with FLOW-05 and VOLATILITY-02 (not measured here).

title: Volume pace vs clock
source: volume.spy_pace_30

labels.volume.spy_pace_30: SPY traded 0.8 times its usual volume for this half hour, in the bottom fifth, higher than 3 of the last 20 sessions at this minute
SPY traded 0.9 times its usual volume for this half hour, between the top and bottom fifths, higher than 9 of the last 20 sessions at this minute
SPY traded 1.7 times its usual volume for this half hour, in the top fifth, higher than 19 of the last 20 sessions at this minute

notes: k / n from 'higher than k of the last n sessions at this minute': bottom third light, top heavy. The label is SPY's volume over the half hour against the same half hour on the prior sessions on file.

title: Volume profile location
source: The last 5 sessions' profile: SPY's minute volume (state/spx_jev/context/bars/{day}.jsonl (prior sessions; the day's own bars cut at the read, or context/{day}.jsonl quotes live)) summed into 5-point bins of SPX's close; a bin at or above the 75th percentile of bin volume is a high-volume node, at or below the 25th low; the bin of SPX's last close, and whether the nearest high-volume node is above or below.
notes: 5 sessions kept. DRAFT: 5-point bins, the quartile cuts.

title: Index move alignment
source: SPY, QQQ and IWM 30-minute returns (state/spx_jev/context/bars/{day}.jsonl (prior sessions; the day's own bars cut at the read, or context/{day}.jsonl quotes live)), each |return| ranked against its own at this minute: a move above the bottom third counts, signed; all three moved the same way = same way; movers both ways = in conflict; no mover = none moved; else mixed.
notes: Rebuilt on QQQ and IWM (no /NQ, /RTY). Shares the participation vote with BREADTH-01/02.

title: Outside markets ahead of SPX, 30 min
source: /ZN, HYG, USO and GLD (state/spx_jev/context/bars/{day}.jsonl (prior sessions; the day's own bars cut at the read, or context/{day}.jsonl quotes live)): each one's 30-minute return beyond its usual multiple of SPX's (BREADTH-07's fit), divided by its residual spread and signed by the multiple's sign (its usual link with stocks), averaged; ranked against the same measure at the same minute on the trailing 20 sessions (at least 10): top fifth up, bottom fifth down, else no clear lean.
notes: Fix applied: /6E dropped, /ZN added; a session without /ZN bars (a bond holiday) is None. The label's hour-by-hour minute link is replaced by the usual multiple's sign.

title: SPX vs what bonds imply since the close
source: SPX's return since the prior close less beta x /ZN's since its 16:00 close (state/spx_jev/context/bars/{day}.jsonl (prior sessions; the day's own bars cut at the read, or context/{day}.jsonl quotes live); beta = the slope of SPX's close-to-close returns on /ZN's over the trailing sessions, at least 10); |gap| ranked against the same at this minute: bottom third nowhere; SPX short of what bonds imply = up, past it = down.
notes: Runs on /ZN now that it is in the feed. Shares MACRO-01's vote.

title: Macro tone since settle (context)
source: /ZN, GLD and HYG since the prior close (state/spx_jev/context/bars/{day}.jsonl (prior sessions; the day's own bars cut at the read, or context/{day}.jsonl quotes live)), each counted when |move| is above the bottom third of its own at this minute: /ZN up and GLD up are risk-off, HYG up risk-on; only risk-on flags = risk-on, only risk-off = risk-off, both = mixed, none = quiet.
notes: Context and gate for MACRO-05, no vote. The yen leg waits on /6J.

title: Do the macro story's sectors confirm it
source: Tone from MACRO-04's legs: yields falling (/ZN up since the close, above the bottom third) expects XHB and IWM beyond SPX up and KRE down (rising: the reverse); oil (USO) moved expects XLE beyond SPX the same way. Each leg's since-the-close return less its usual multiple of SPX's; more matches than mismatches = confirm, more mismatches = contradict, no tone or a tie = nothing.
notes: DRAFT rubric (J2-21's map, as code): the regional banks lag on falling yields; no transports symbol, so the energy-vs-transports leg is energy alone. Gate for MACRO-03, no vote.

title: Stock-bond link: today vs normal (conditioner)
source: The correlation of SPX's and /ZN's 1-minute returns since 09:35 (state/spx_jev/context/bars/{day}.jsonl (prior sessions; the day's own bars cut at the read, or context/{day}.jsonl quotes live), at least 20 shared minutes): past +0.2 together, under -0.2 opposite, else unlinked; |correlation| ranked against the same at this minute: top half stronger than usual, else weaker.
notes: Conditioner for MACRO-01's bond leg, no vote. DRAFT: the 0.2 line, the half split.

title: Rates tape busy vs normal
source: /ZN's volume over the last 30 minutes (state/spx_jev/context/bars/{day}.jsonl (prior sessions; the day's own bars cut at the read, or context/{day}.jsonl quotes live)) ranked against the same half hour on the trailing sessions: bottom third quiet, top busy.
notes: The 10-minute companion is not built. Fold into VOLATILITY-02 if > 0.8.

title: Scheduled event in window
source: calendar/events.json at the read (events.session_rows: every tier but the minor pre-open releases): a row under way (start <= now < end) first; then one started within the last 15 minutes (just out); then one due within 60 minutes, tier 1 or a lower tier; else nothing. A day the calendar does not cover is None.
notes: The auction tier has a shape and no rows: the answer is honest to the rows present, so no auction is ever named until rows are added. learn_exclude still drops reads with an event in window, so the due states cannot earn weight yet.

title: Event-day phase
source: Fixed tier map on calendar/events.json: high = FOMC, FOMC_PRESSER, CPI, JOBS, PCE; medium = PPI, RETAIL_SALES, GDP, ISM_MANUFACTURING, ISM_SERVICES, JOLTS, FOMC_MINUTES, FED_CHAIR_TESTIMONY, FED_CHAIR_JACKSON_HOLE, CONSUMER_CONFIDENCE, UMICH_SENTIMENT. In order: a high-tier row today; the next trading day high (eve); the previous trading day high (day after); a medium row today; else ordinary. Uncovered days are None.
notes: Fix applied: a fixed tier map instead of a learned yearly ranking.

title: Follow-through after the latest release
source: The latest calendar row whose first 15 minutes are over, within 120 minutes of the read (Fed statement and presser are separate rows). In the session: SPX closes at the row's start, 15 minutes after, and now; before the open: /ES night bars at those minutes and the read's /ES quote as now. Back through the start = reversed; past the 15-minute price by more than 0.05 sigma = extended; more than half given back = faded; else held.
notes: Release types pooled (one verdict for data, Fed remarks and the presser). The rank against past releases is not applied: the verdict uses the fixed 0.05-sigma and half-line rules of labels/events_shocks.py.

title: Rates surprise at the latest release
source: The latest calendar row whose first 15 minutes are over (as EVENTS-03): /ZN's return over those 15 minutes (its session bars, or its night bars before the open); |return| ranked against every row's 15-minute /ZN return on the trailing 20 sessions (at least 10 rows): top third large, signed by yields (/ZN up = yields down); else small.
notes: Distinct from MACRO-01's rolling gap. Needs 10 prior rows with /ZN bars.

title: Month-turn rebalance side and size
source: The day's place among the month's trading days (sessions.is_trading_day): the first 3 = new-month inflow; the last 2 = the month-to-date $SPX minus TLT return (daily_closes, the last close before the day against the prior month's last close) ranked against every full month on file: top fifth sell big, then sell, small, buy, bottom fifth buy big; other days None.
notes: Fix applied: the daily-closes job's $SPX and TLT closes (from 2016) replace the hard-coded flows.rebalance_side. Shadow.

title: Leveraged ETF bull/bear tilt
source: SPXL + TQQQ minus SPXS + SQQQ dollar volume (close x volume, state/spx_jev/context/bars/{day}.jsonl (prior sessions; the day's own bars cut at the read, or context/{day}.jsonl quotes live)) over the last 30 minutes as a share of the five funds' total, less what SPX's 30-minute move predicts (a line fitted on the prior sessions' half hours, at least 20); the residual ranked against the same measure at the same minute on the trailing 20 sessions (at least 10): top third high, bottom low.
notes: The four funds are in the feed since 08-21 (thin, missing a few minutes a day). Read contrarian by the learners, not here. Untested; shadow.

title: SPY book lean (log only)
source: Resting size at SPY's best bid against the best offer over the last 5 minutes, ranked against this minute on the prior sessions.
notes: needs_new_feed: the lob-flow collector's SPY depth fold keeps the combined size only (the spy_depth engine's size|spy baseline rows); a bid/ask split needs the engine's snapshot changed, not a pure addition to the daemon. Always None until the split is saved. Log only, no vote.
